description: Major pothole on main road near school entrance. Child fell from bicycle.
Streetlight not working for two weeks. Road very dark at night.
Lake overflowed onto road after heavy rain. Vehicles stuck.
Heritage wall cracked and falling apart. Plaques damaged.
Construction noise continuing past 11pm. Residents unable to sleep.
Garbage dumping behind apartments. Overflowing bins and scattered waste.
Drain blocked under flyover. Sewage water on road during rain.
Manhole cover missing. Risk of serious injury to pedestrians.
Heatwave conditions. Elderly residents exposed to scorching sun with no shade.
Deep road crack extending 5 meters. Vehicles hitting the crack.
Wedding DJ playing loud music past midnight on weeknight.
Heritage monument showing signs of neglect. Cracks on ancient structure.
Streetlight sparking. Electrical hazard near residential area.
Flooded street after 1 hour of rain. Water entering ground floor homes.
Dead animal on road for 3 days. Health hazard for commuters.
